accepted: Keep a thin Creator-facing repair instruction and put benchmark governance in the external harness.
Give the baseline the same model, tools, time, attempts, and feedback surface.
Freeze the loop and held-out contract before a new known-Grok development run.
Keep the broad validator and 48,000-byte package cap unchanged.
Require held-out evidence with no critical failures before an improvement claim.
rejectedOrNarrowed: A harness-only treatment would not test the user-approved Creator behavior hypothesis, so the product receives a 261-byte activated-core delta.
Token usage is reported cost rather than an eligibility cap; attempt and wall-clock limits keep the experiment bounded.
